dedupe_keys.name: gtfs realtime differential to full feed converter

description: This Node.js package turns a stream of GTFS Realtime differential messages into a current full-dataset message. It accepts FeedMessage-shaped JavaScript objects through a writable stream, keeps still-relevant entities in memory, and returns a protocol-buffer-encoded FULL_DATASET message. Users set a time-to-live period so old changes expire. The README gives npm installation and a short code example, and the repository carries an ISC licence. The project explicitly says its implementation does not exactly follow the draft DIFFERENTIAL specification; users need to test deletion and expiry behaviour against their feed before relying on a reconstructed state. This review read the public README and file tree, not the source code or a running feed. It did not install the package. Its scope is any public-transit GTFS Realtime feed that emits differential updates, so temporal and geographic coverage come from the user’s source feed, not the tool. A transport modeller could prepare a stable vehicle or trip-update snapshot for a simulation input. Related catalogue resource data-gtfs-specification defines the feed standard; this package is a specific conversion utility, not a transit dataset.
name: GTFS Realtime differential-to-full feed converter
